semiconductor_relevance: High — Vital Fluid Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in gas mass flow measurement and control systems, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Vital Fluid Technology Co., Ltd. provides advanced gas delivery systems, including mass flow controllers (MFC), flow proportional controllers (FRC), and pressure controllers (PC), essential for semiconductor fabrication. The company has a strong focus on meeting the needs of advanced semiconductor processes, leveraging its expertise in fluid technology.

regional_presence.China: The company is strategically positioned in China, benefiting from local semiconductor market growth and demand.
